from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancingCashFlow(BaseModel):
    """Financing cash flow figure from one company's financial statements."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Company name as reported in the filing")
    label: str | None = Field(description="Line-item label as written (e.g. 'Net cash from financing activities', 'Net cash used in financing activities')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="Cash flow amount; positive = inflow, negative = outflow")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale, e.g. 'thousands', 'millions', or 'dollars'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period covered, e.g. 'three months ended March 31, 2024'")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Short verbatim excerpt from the statement")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financing_cash_flows: list[FinancingCashFlow]
